objective: Build pilot-scale evidence for the SDSS point-supervised catalog-generation benchmark and compare a lightweight UNet against the compact baseline.

variants.objective: Validate shard-aware data loading throughput before full pilot runs.
variants.hypothesis: Grouped shard loading with a one-shard cache should produce a checkpoint and measurable throughput on the fixed pilot split.

variants.objective: Establish the first non-limited baseline pilot evidence point.
variants.hypothesis: The compact baseline should produce nonzero AP and recall on the fixed 100-field pilot split after 5 epochs.

variants.objective: Compare lightweight multiscale features against the compact baseline on pilot evidence.
variants.hypothesis: The lightweight UNet should improve AP or recall over the compact baseline under the same fixed split and training budget.

variants.objective: Run paper-scale baseline pilot training for stable comparison.
variants.hypothesis: The compact baseline should provide a stable 50-epoch pilot reference under the fixed split.

variants.objective: Run paper-scale lightweight UNet pilot training for architecture evidence.
variants.hypothesis: The lightweight UNet should produce stronger 50-epoch pilot AP or recall than the compact baseline.

variants.objective: Probe UNet-lite batch-size 192 throughput and memory without changing completed e50 evidence.
variants.hypothesis: UNet-lite batch size 192 should increase GPU memory use while remaining below the 20GB reserved-memory probe gate.

variants.objective: Probe UNet-lite batch-size 256 throughput if batch size 192 is stable.
variants.hypothesis: UNet-lite batch size 256 may be stable if peak reserved memory at 192 is well below 20GB.

variants.objective: Probe baseline batch-size 192 throughput under the same limited protocol as UNet-lite.
variants.hypothesis: The compact baseline should fit batch size 192 and provide matched throughput context.

variants.objective: Probe baseline batch-size 256 throughput under the same limited protocol as UNet-lite.
variants.hypothesis: The compact baseline should fit batch size 256 and provide matched throughput context if UNet-lite can be tested there.

variants.objective: Screen the full PSF-constrained point-supervised UNet-lite method for ablation comparison.
variants.hypothesis: The full loss should reproduce candidate evidence before loss-term ablations are scaled.

variants.objective: Screen whether removing PSF reconstruction weakens the UNet-lite method.
variants.hypothesis: Setting PSF reconstruction weight to zero should reduce evidence if the PSF constraint contributes useful supervision.

variants.objective: Screen center-only point heatmap supervision against the full UNet-lite method.
variants.hypothesis: Center-only supervision should underperform the PSF-constrained full loss if reconstruction and auxiliary heads matter.

variants.objective: Extend no-PSF ablation to 20 epochs only if the e5 screen passes the candidate gate.
variants.hypothesis: A 20-epoch no-PSF run should clarify whether the gap is a loss-term effect rather than early optimization noise.

variants.objective: Extend center-only ablation to 20 epochs only if the e5 screen passes the candidate gate.
variants.hypothesis: A 20-epoch center-only run should clarify whether auxiliary losses improve detection in faint or crowded regimes.
